message.reasoning_content: need to determine statutory charge(s) based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: Defendant found victim's phone, then used Alipay small amount password-free payment to steal 3723 RMB from victim's Alipay account. That's theft (盗窃罪) via electronic means. Could also be "非法获取他人金融账户信息罪"? Under Chinese law, unauthorized use of Alipay to transfer money is theft. Also "侵犯公民个人信息罪"? But main is theft. Also "诈骗罪"? He didn't deceive, he just accessed account. So theft (盗窃罪) using electronic means, maybe "盗窃罪（利用信息网络盗窃）". Under Criminal Law article 264 (theft). So answer: [罪名]盗窃罪<eoa>. The format: [罪名]盗窃<eoa> or with 罪. Example shows "盗窃". Use "盗窃". So final.
